title: Appendix D. Final decision summary
tables:
RECOMMENDED FLAGSHIP DECISION
Use APEX XR as the maximum-configuration reference platform and partner vision. Budget ~₹55 lakh for a first complete engineering unit, retain the proposed ₹89 lakh + GST commercial anchor only as preliminary planning, and do not allow flagship scope to dilute the focused PoC-to-validation program.
Stage subsystems behind evidence gates; metrology and controlled incubation first, direct MIC second, automation and research modules after.
Lock one intended workflow and validate it deeply before expanding organisms, drugs, methods or turnaround claims.
Use APEX as an open, data-rich platform but label experimental modules and outputs clearly.
Sell modular value, not a compulsory all-in-one configuration. APEX anchors the ceiling; lower tiers carry focused workflows.
We digitize and standardize microbiology; we do not reinvent the underlying method or replace expert accountability.
